claim: G7 portal notification MVP must preserve v2 adapter seams (version, type, event_type, ts, source, data, payload envelope fields) without implementing v2.1 GossipMesh replication, v2.5 safety overlays, or mesh endpoints in the v1 MVP branch. Test constants lock the future-spec references so later edits cannot silently expand scope.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14: G7-Async-notifications-mvp branch aligned with docs/v2 specs; tests and constants prevent scope creep into mesh/safety features.
